name: Carnation Industries Limited
about: Carnation Industries Limited engages in the manufacture of foundry-based engineering goods. The company offers castings; ferrous and non-metals; iron and steel; and other products. It also engages in manufacturing, processing, bottling, trading, importing, exporting and distributing alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, including wines, beer, whisky, gin, rum, brandy, Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL), other spirits, aerated waters, mineral water, soda, juices, energy drinks and related beverage products. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in New Delhi, India.
